d:
A fabulous song, very well picturised, popular still today; that's called the magic of the golden era of the Indian Cinema.
Performers: Dev Anand, Waheeda Rehman, Sunder (playing mouth organ), Jagdev Bhambri (sitting along with Waheeda Rehman)
Music Director: SD Burman
Singer: Hemant Kumar
Lyricist: Majrooh Sultanpuri
The credit for the restoration of this song goes to Thomas Daniel (YouTube channel - tommydan333). Since this song is among my favorites, I have uploaded it on this channel.
